product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

reviews.author: Zachary Stone
reviews.comment: Super clean black tee. The tape detailing along the sleeves makes it look way more expensive than it is. Very happy with this.

reviews.author: Aaron Flynn
reviews.comment: Great everyday shirt. Fits perfectly and the tape details give it a sporty edge without being too casual.

reviews.author: Elliot Nash
reviews.comment: Really solid quality tee. The fabric is thick enough to feel premium but breathable for warmer days.

faqs.question: What are the tape details made of?
faqs.answer: The tape details are woven fabric trims stitched along the cuffs and collar for a sporty, refined finish.

faqs.question: Does this shirt shrink after washing?
faqs.answer: The fabric is pre-shrunk. Washing in cold water will help maintain the original fit and shape.

faqs.question: Is this shirt suitable for gym or sport use?
faqs.answer: It has a sporty aesthetic but is designed for casual everyday wear rather than high-intensity athletic activity.

reviews.author: Chris Watson
reviews.comment: These jeans fit great and the stretch makes them very comfortable throughout the day. Good value at the discounted price.

reviews.author: Ben Harrison
reviews.comment: Decent jeans overall but the waistband runs a little tight. Recommend sizing up by one for a better fit.

reviews.author: Jake Coleman
reviews.comment: Good quality denim but feels slightly thinner than expected. The distressed detailing looks natural though.

faqs.question: Do these jeans have stretch?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 2% elastane content provides a comfortable stretch for ease of movement throughout the day.

faqs.question: Should I size up or down?
faqs.answer: We recommend sizing up by one size for a more comfortable fit around the waist and thighs.

faqs.question: Are the distressed details pre-made?
faqs.answer: Yes, the distressing is factory-treated so the jeans arrive with a worn-in look straight out of the bag.

product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry medium

reviews.author: Patrick O'Brien
reviews.comment: One of my favorite flannel shirts. The plaid is bold and eye-catching and it layers perfectly over any tee.

reviews.author: Marcus Lee
reviews.comment: Really well constructed shirt. Feels premium and the flannel is thick and cozy — perfect for colder months.

reviews.author: Tobias Grant
reviews.comment: Classic flannel shirt done right. True to size and the colors are vibrant even after several washes.

faqs.question: Is this shirt suitable for layering?
faqs.answer: Yes, the regular fit makes it ideal to wear open over a t-shirt or buttoned up on its own.

faqs.question: Does this shirt shrink after washing?
faqs.answer: The fabric is pre-washed to minimize shrinkage. Washing on a warm rather than hot cycle is recommended.

faqs.question: Can this be worn in summer?
faqs.answer: Due to its flannel fabric, this shirt is best suited for autumn and winter. For warmer months, we recommend our lighter cotton shirts.

product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

reviews.author: Liam Turner
reviews.comment: The orange and black colorway is bold and eye-catching. Very comfortable and fits exactly as expected.

reviews.author: Noah Barnes
reviews.comment: Excellent value at the discounted price. The contrasting raglan sleeves make this tee look unique and stylish.

reviews.author: Connor Walsh
reviews.comment: Great quality for the price. The fabric is soft and the color stays vibrant after washing. Very satisfied.

faqs.question: Does the orange color fade quickly?
faqs.answer: To preserve the color, wash inside out in cold water and avoid direct sunlight when line drying.

faqs.question: Where are the stripes — on the body or sleeves?
faqs.answer: The vertical stripes are on the body of the shirt while the raglan sleeves are solid in a contrasting color.

faqs.question: Is this shirt good for casual and sporty looks?
faqs.answer: Yes, the raglan sleeve design gives it a sporty aesthetic that works well for both casual outings and relaxed athletic wear.
